name: 92677 · Laguna Niguel, CA
findings: ZIP 92677 (Laguna Niguel) has 218 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92677 (Laguna Niguel) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92677 (Laguna Niguel) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 94 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
